cues.en: I hope that you remember the videos on Gradient Descent from the section on applications of derivatives.
cues.zh: 希望你還記得，導數應用那一節的梯度下降影片。

cues.en: Now there we discussed single variable gradient descent, but it turns out that gradient descent is really easy to extend to multiple dimensions.
cues.zh: 當時討論單變數梯度下降，但其實，梯度下降很容易延伸到多個維度。

cues.en: And that's what I'm going to explain in this video.
cues.zh: 這就是這支影片要解釋的。

cues.en: I want to begin actually by reminding you of the algorithm for gradient descent.
cues.zh: 我想先提醒你，梯度下降的演算法。

cues.en: This is a screenshot of a slide from the video on single variable or one dimensional gradient descent.
cues.zh: 這是單變數、一維梯度下降影片的投影片截圖。

cues.en: So brief reminder, the idea of gradient descent is to find the minimum of a function.
cues.zh: 快速複習，梯度下降的想法，是找出函數的極小值。

cues.en: That is our goal.
cues.zh: 這是目標。

cues.en: To find the minimum of a function using an iterative optimization algorithm.
cues.zh: 使用迭代最佳化演算法，找出函數的極小值。

cues.en: Now you start by guessing some random point somewhere in the domain of X, and of course this is unlikely
cues.zh: 從 x 定義域內，隨機猜一點開始。當然，這不太可能

cues.en: to correspond to the minimum of the function, but this is just a place to start.
cues.zh: 就是函數極小值，但只是一個起點。

cues.en: Then in a for loop, you evaluate the derivative of the function at that point and then you update the
cues.zh: 接著，在 for 迴圈裡，計算函數在那點的導數，再把

cues.en: guess of the minimum or the x location where the function minimum occurs as itself minus the derivative
cues.zh: 對極小值位置，也就是函數極小值所在 x 位置的猜測，更新成它自己減去導數，

cues.en: time.
cues.zh: 乘以，

cues.en: Some constant and this is called the learning rate.
cues.zh: 某個常數，叫作學習率。

cues.en: It's just a small number.
cues.zh: 只是個小數。

cues.en: It's somewhere around 0.001, for example.
cues.zh: 例如大約 0.001。

cues.en: And the whole point of the learning rate is to slow down the learning to make it more numerically stable.
cues.zh: 學習率的目的，就是減緩學習，讓數值更穩定。

cues.en: And then you stay inside this loop until either a set number of iterations has been completed or some criterion has been achieved.
cues.zh: 接著一直留在迴圈裡，直到完成指定迭代次數，或達到某個準則。

cues.en: For example, the magnitude of this derivative gets really small, and then the idea is that the final value of x sub M is really close to the true function minimum.
cues.zh: 例如導數的量值變得很小。想法是，最後的 xₘ，會非常接近真正的函數極小值位置。

cues.en: Okay, so that is for single variable gradient descent.
cues.zh: 好，這是單變數梯度下降。

cues.en: How do we extend this algorithm to any number of dimensions?
cues.zh: 如何把演算法延伸到任意維度？

cues.en: Well, it's really easy.
cues.zh: 非常簡單。

cues.en: You don't actually do anything.
cues.zh: 其實什麼都不用做。

cues.en: Well, okay, that's not entirely true.
cues.zh: 好吧，也不完全是。

cues.en: But the algorithm and the concept and the math is exactly the same.
cues.zh: 但演算法、概念與數學完全相同。

cues.en: In fact, multi dimensional or multi variable gradient descent is just one dimensional gradient descent on each dimension.
cues.zh: 事實上，多維度、多變數梯度下降，就是在每個維度上做一維梯度下降。

cues.en: So each variable in the function.
cues.zh: 也就是函數的每個變數。

cues.en: Now, that doesn't mean you have more to keep track of, more variables, more derivatives to keep track of.
cues.zh: 這確實表示，要追蹤更多東西，更多變數、更多導數。

cues.en: And so in practice, all of the variables are put into a vector to transform the set of individual derivatives
cues.zh: 所以實務上，把所有變數放進向量，讓個別導數的集合，轉成

cues.en: into a gradient of the multi variable function.
cues.zh: 多變數函數的梯度。

cues.en: But fundamentally, multi variable gradient descent is the same algorithm and more or less the same code as for single variable gradient descent.
cues.zh: 但根本而言，多變數梯度下降與單變數使用相同的演算法，程式碼也大致相同。

cues.en: Well, that's all I have to say here in the code challenge.
cues.zh: 好，這裡要說的就這些。在程式挑戰，

cues.en: In the next video you will have the opportunity to implement two dimensional gradient descent.
cues.zh: 也就是下一支影片，你會有機會實作二維梯度下降。

cues.en: Now, if you feel like you would benefit from a refresher on the mechanism of gradient descent, then
cues.zh: 如果覺得需要複習梯度下降的運作方式，

cues.en: feel free to go back and rewatch the video on single variable gradient descent in the section on applications.
cues.zh: 歡迎回到應用那一節，重看單變數梯度下降的影片。
